annotations.title: Create a new API or LMS (LTI 1

description: Create a new API or LMS (LTI 1.0/1.1 or 1.3) integration. Returns the integration identification string, get its keys with edubase_get_integration_keys.

lti.description: LTI version, required for LMS integrations

organization.description: organization identification string to assign the integration to, only an organization of the API application owner can be used, always the organization of the user for organizational members

platform.description: LMS platform URL, only necessary for LMS integrations!

secret_lifetime.description: optional secret lifetime in days, 0 for never (default), not for LTI 1.3, capped by policy

name: edubase_post_integration
